tour.overview:
San Francisco sits on a peninsula of steep hills between the Pacific and the Bay, with the Golden Gate Bridge, opened in 1937 and painted 'International Orange', spanning the strait at its tip. In the bay, Alcatraz Island held a federal prison from 1934 to 1963, home to inmates such as Al Capone. The city's cable cars, running since 1873, still climb its hills.

This private day takes you through the highlights with a local guide and a vehicle, from Alcatraz to the redwoods of Muir Woods across the bridge.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 9 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in San Francisco
• Type: private tour with local guide, vehicle and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Alcatraz.
• The Golden Gate Bridge.
• Cable cars, Lombard Street and Chinatown.
• The Painted Ladies.
• Muir Woods.

WHY THIS WORKS
Alcatraz tickets sell out weeks ahead; we book them, and the vehicle links the hills, the bridge and the redwoods.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors, families, couples.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For nature, choose our Yosemite day trip or the Big Sur coast.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
San Francisco is often foggy and cool, even in summer. Muir Woods requires a parking reservation, which we arrange.

days.name: Alcatraz, a cable car, Lombard Street, Chinatown, the Painted Ladies, the Golden Gate Bridge and Muir Woods
days.description:
What to expect: the city’s landmarks and the redwoods, with a local guide, private vehicle and tickets.

Your guide collects you at about 8:15 and takes you to Pier 33 for the ferry to Alcatraz. On the island, the award-winning audio tour, narrated by former guards and inmates, leads you through the cellhouse, the dining hall and the recreation yard, and tells the story of the 1962 escape and the Native American occupation of 1969–71.

Back on land, you ride a cable car over Nob Hill, then walk down the brick switchbacks of Lombard Street among flowerbeds. You walk through Chinatown, with its dragon gate, temples and bakeries, and have lunch (not included). Your driver takes you to Alamo Square to see the Painted Ladies, Victorian houses against the skyline.

In the afternoon you go to the Golden Gate Bridge: you walk part of the walkway, then cross it to Battery Spencer for the classic view of the bridge with the city behind. You end in Muir Woods, where trails lead among coast redwoods, the tallest trees on Earth, some over 75 metres tall and more than 800 years old, before returning to the city.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:15 – Pick-up at your hotel.
09:00 – Ferry to Alcatraz.
11:30 – Cable car and Lombard Street.
12:15 – Chinatown and lunch.
13:45 – Painted Ladies.
14:30 – Golden Gate Bridge walk and Battery Spencer.
15:30 – Muir Woods.
17:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Alcatraz night tours can be arranged.
• Sausalito can be added for a waterfront stroll.
• Bring a warm layer for the fog.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, local guide, Alcatraz, cable car, Muir Woods, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: none.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Are Alcatraz tickets included?
faq.answer: Yes. They sell out weeks in advance, so book early.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: No. Your guide suggests dim sum in Chinatown or another restaurant.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Children love Alcatraz and the cable car. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Alcatraz has a tram up the hill; Muir Woods has flat boardwalks.

faq.question: Can we cycle across the bridge?
faq.answer: Yes, on request, instead of walking.

faq.question: What if Alcatraz is sold out?
faq.answer: We suggest another date or replace it with a bay cruise.

faq.question: Can we add wine country?
faq.answer: Yes. Napa or Sonoma can be visited on another day.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: No. There are no commission stops.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers and a windproof jacket; San Francisco is cool and foggy, even in summer.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: September and October are the sunniest; summer is often foggy.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in the United States: 15 to 20 percent is usual for guides and drivers if you were happy with the service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
